_: Pre-flight command linter rules. Catches MODEL command-syntax bugs BEFORE the row hits the executor — the model sees the rejection diagnostic via wait_for_outcome and self-corrects.

rules.hint: ssh syntax bug: 'user@' (quoted) breaks because the quotes terminate before the host, so SSH sees an empty hostname after the @. Use `ssh user@host port_args` (no quotes around user@host), OR use `ssh -l user host port_args`.

Android executor denies raw sockets (executor_caps_note says this). nmap WITHOUT `-Pn -sT` will fail with 'route_dst_netlink: if_indextoname(2) failed: 13 Permission denied'. Always pass `-Pn -sT` when nmap targets the tablet's wlan0 LAN.
